newsitem.title: CHINA: Samsung China investment to hit $2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Samsung China investment to hit $2 bln.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Corp plans to expand its investment in China to $2.0 billion by the year 2000, the International Business Daily said on Monday.
Samsung would invest $1.0 billion in a semiconductor production line in China, the newspaper said.
The project would be the industrial giant's biggest single overseas investment, it said but gave no further details.
The company would also enter into a mid-sized passenger jet venture with a Chinese partner before 1998, the newspaper said but did not elaborate.
